Title: Registration form, required fields, masking and confirmation
Environment: Deployed Web; desktop and mobile browser
Preconditions: User is logged out and the Web application is reachable.
Steps: 1. Open the unauthenticated landing page. 2. Select Create Account. 3. Inspect required indicators. 4. Submit with all fields empty. 5. Enter different Password and Confirm Password values. 6. Enter a password and operate Show/Hide.
Expected: Registration opens with Username, Email address, Password, Confirm password, Age and Avatar marked required; empty and mismatched fields block submission with field-level feedback; password is masked by default and Show/Hide works.
Actual: Required username/email/password/confirmation, masking, mismatch and Age step were observed. Team confirmed Age is optional, so Age/Avatar without * is accepted.

Title: Username boundaries, trimming and uniqueness
Preconditions: A synthetic account named ExistingExplorer exists.
Steps: 1. Try usernames of 2 and 21 characters. 2. Enter a valid username padded with spaces and submit valid remaining data. 3. Try the same trimmed username with different case.
Expected: Out-of-range values are rejected with the approved message; outer spaces are removed before validation; the duplicate is rejected and no second account is created.
Actual: Username length, trimming and uniqueness matched the approved behaviour.

Title: Email validation and successful account creation
Preconditions: User is logged out; a unique synthetic email is available.
Steps: 1. Complete registration with malformed email and submit. 2. Correct the email and submit once. 3. Observe the destination and sign-in state.
Expected: Malformed email is rejected with the approved message; valid submission creates exactly one account, displays success and enters the authenticated experience.
Actual: Malformed email was rejected; valid registration created one account and entered the authenticated experience.

Title: Duplicate submission and registration failure handling
Preconditions: Registration form contains valid unique synthetic data.
Steps: 1. Throttle the request and press Create Account repeatedly. 2. Verify one account only. 3. Repeat with the API unavailable. 4. Restore service and retry once.
Expected: Repeated presses produce one account; server/network failure is distinguished, leaves no partial/duplicate account and permits a safe retry.
Actual: Repeated submission created one account; registration network/server failure was recoverable and created no partial account.

Title: Valid, invalid and empty login paths
Preconditions: A synthetic registered account exists and user is logged out.
Steps: 1. Submit empty login fields. 2. Submit an incorrect password. 3. Submit valid username/password. 4. Log out and submit valid email/password.
Data: Known username/email; correct and incorrect passwords
Expected: Empty fields are highlighted without submission; invalid credentials are denied with a clear error; username and email login both open the correct account.
Actual: Empty fields, invalid credentials and valid username/email login behaved as specified.

Title: Saved progress, connectivity failure and logout
Preconditions: Account has at least one saved discovery/card; user can control network locally.
Steps: 1. Log in and verify saved collection/progress. 2. Log out. 3. Confirm authenticated pages are inaccessible. 4. Disable network and attempt a valid login.
Expected: Saved data belongs to the account; logout ends the session and returns to unauthenticated UI; connectivity failure is not reported as invalid credentials.
Actual: Saved progress was restored; logout ended the session; login connectivity failure was not reported as invalid credentials.

Title: Open recovery and validate invalid email input
Preconditions: User is logged out.
Steps: 1. Select Forgot Password. 2. Submit an empty email. 3. Submit a malformed email. 4. Submit an unregistered valid-format email.
Expected: Recovery page and Send Recovery Link action are displayed; empty, malformed and unlinked email values show inline errors and do not submit.
Actual: Recovery page opened; empty and malformed emails showed inline errors.

Title: Reject unlinked recovery email
Preconditions: User is logged out; no account exists for the test email.
Steps: 1. Select Forgot Password. 2. Enter a valid-format email that is not linked to any RimbaQuest account. 3. Select Send Recovery Link.
Expected: The recovery request is not submitted and an inline error identifies that the email is not linked to an account.
Actual: Unlinked valid-format email was not submitted and showed inline feedback.

Title: Display profile and open permitted editing
Preconditions: Child is logged in and has known collection progress.
Steps: 1. Open Profile. 2. Compare username, level, avatar and progress with account data. 3. Select Edit Profile.
Expected: Profile displays the required values; editing opens with permitted username and avatar controls.
Actual: Profile displayed required values; Edit Profile opened username and avatar controls.

Title: Update username and avatar consistently
Preconditions: Two accounts exist; child is logged into the first.
Steps: 1. Try the second account username and invalid length values. 2. Save a unique valid username and different approved avatar. 3. Revisit relevant screens. 4. Log out and log in with old then new username.
Data: Unique valid username; duplicate username; approved avatar
Expected: Invalid/duplicate names are rejected; valid username and avatar persist consistently; old username no longer logs in and new username does.
Actual: Username and avatar updates persisted and subsequent login used the new username.

Title: Warn before discarding unsaved profile changes
Preconditions: Child is editing profile.
Steps: 1. Change username and avatar without saving. 2. Navigate back. 3. Choose remain. 4. Navigate back again and choose discard.
Expected: A warning offers remain or discard; remain keeps editing state; discard leaves without applying changes.
Actual: Unsaved profile changes offered remain or discard.

Title: Open six-location list with non-guaranteed wording
Preconditions: Child is logged in; location service is available.
Steps: 1. Select Discover Locations. 2. Count and identify location cards. 3. Inspect wildlife wording on every card.
Data: Approved six KL/Klang Valley location IDs
Expected: Discover Locations opens with exactly the approved six locations and wording indicates possible/previous observations without guaranteeing sightings.
Actual: Discover Locations opened the six KL/Klang Valley locations without guaranteed-sighting wording.

Title: Location loading state
Preconditions: Child is logged in and the locations response can be delayed.
Steps: 1. Delay the locations response. 2. Open Discover Locations. 3. Verify the loading state before the response completes. 4. Release the response and verify the location list loads.
Expected: A loading indicator or placeholder appears while locations are retrieved; No locations found is not shown before loading completes; the location list appears after the response succeeds.
Actual: A delayed locations GET showed Loading wildlife locations... and did not show No locations found before the list loaded.

Title: Search field, name, area, case, partial and no results
Preconditions: Discover Locations page has loaded the approved six locations.
Steps: 1. Verify search field location and placeholder. 2. Search full and partial location names. 3. Search by area. 4. Repeat KL as kl, KL and Kl. 5. Search an impossible term.
Expected: Search field says Search locations or areas; matching cards alone remain; partial, area and case variants work; no match displays No matching locations found and not a system error.
Actual: Search field, name, area, case, partial and no-results behaviour matched.

Title: Open camera interface and controls
Preconditions: Child is logged in; camera permission is granted.
Steps: 1. Select Record a Discovery. 2. Wait for camera readiness. 3. Inspect preview, capture, gallery, exit and guidance controls.
Expected: Camera opens and all specified controls, live preview and child guidance are visible and usable.
Actual: Record a Discovery opened the camera interface with preview, capture, gallery, exit and child guidance.

Title: Capture/gallery photo, preview and automatic progression
Preconditions: Camera and photo-library permissions are granted.
Steps: 1. Capture one photo and inspect review. 2. Return and choose one gallery image. 3. Enlarge preview where supported. 4. Observe next screen and retained image.
Expected: Exactly one image is captured/selected and clearly reviewed; accepted image automatically opens category selection and remains attached to the discovery.
Actual: Camera capture and gallery selection each produced one reviewable image; enlargement worked; accepted photo opened category selection.

Title: No-photo, replacement and upload failure paths
Preconditions: Child is on camera screen.
Steps: 1. Attempt to proceed without a photo. 2. Select a photo then retake/replace it. 3. Disable network during processing. 4. Restore and use Try Again.
Expected: No-photo path cannot reach category selection; replacement image supersedes the first; failure shows the approved message and Try Again without losing safe state.
Actual: Web UI still requires a photo. 3 September 2026 automated rerun on 93c3a03: no-photo API confirmation returns 400; synthetic JPEG upload and photo-backed discovery succeed.
Evidence: UI-23-discovery-photo; DEP-API-17; UI-11-card-gallery; UI-28-gallery-after-discovery; SUP-AC3-1-8-Pass; SUP-AC3-1-9-Fail

Title: Category screen, visual categories and category-specific species
Environment: Physical device or deployed Web with uploaded image
Preconditions: A valid photo was accepted.
Steps: 1. Observe automatic category screen. 2. Verify Mammals, Birds, Butterflies and Reptiles with names/images. 3. Select each category in turn and inspect species results.
Expected: Four visually recognisable categories appear; selecting one stores it, opens species selection and shows only supported species in that category.
Actual: Four visual categories appeared; selecting one opened only that category's species.

Title: Change category while retaining photo and inspect species references
Preconditions: Photo retained; child is on a species list.
Steps: 1. Inspect species name, reference image and category. 2. Use Back. 3. Choose another category. 4. Confirm original photo remains.
Expected: Species reference information is complete; Back permits category replacement without losing the photo.
Actual: Species references were complete; Back retained the photo while changing category.

Title: Species search partial, case and clear behavior
Preconditions: Mammal species list is open.
Steps: 1. Search a full name. 2. Search a partial name. 3. repeat with lower/upper/mixed case. 4. Search an impossible term. 5. Clear the field.
Expected: Only common-name matches in the selected category appear; partial and case-insensitive matching works; no match displays the approved message; clearing restores all category species.
Actual: Partial, case-insensitive, no-match and clear species search matched.

Title: Store exactly one selected species
Preconditions: Multiple species are displayed.
Steps: 1. Select one species. 2. Return and select another before confirmation. 3. Inspect confirmation.
Expected: Only the latest selected species is stored for the discovery; no multiple-species state is created.
Actual: Exactly one selected species was stored for the discovery.

Title: Enlarge photo and choose automatic/manual location
Preconditions: Confirmation screen has photo/species; location permission is granted.
Steps: 1. Enlarge and close photo. 2. Verify state unchanged. 3. Choose current location. 4. Restart flow and choose manual location.
Expected: Enlarging preserves discovery state; current location is obtained at submission time; manual option accepts an appropriate discovery location.
Actual: Photo enlargement preserved state; automatic and manual location options worked.

Title: Permission fallback, required summary and choose another species
Preconditions: Confirmation screen is open; location permission can be denied.
Steps: 1. Deny location after Use My Current Location. 2. Choose manual fallback. 3. Verify photo, common name, category and location. 4. Choose Another Species.
Expected: Denial is explained and does not block progress; manual fallback works; summary is complete; returning retains photo/category while allowing species replacement.
Actual: Denied GPS fallback and required summary passed. Back from Confirm Discovery retained photo and category and allowed another species to be selected. Team accepted Back as Choose Another Species.

Title: No pre-confirm save, success navigation and save retry
Preconditions: Valid confirmation data is present.
Steps: 1. Before confirming, inspect collection/progress. 2. Confirm and observe success. 3. Repeat a new flow with save failure. 4. Verify retained data and retry.
Expected: No record/card exists before explicit confirmation; successful save opens Success; failure shows approved message, retains all four data elements and offers a working retry.
Actual: No pre-confirm save and success navigation passed. Manual retest on 3 September 2026 against 93c3a03 confirmed the approved save-failure copy.

Title: Save repeat observations separately
Preconditions: Child already has one confirmed observation of the selected species.
Steps: 1. Complete and confirm another valid discovery of the same species. 2. Open that species gallery.
Expected: Second observation is saved as a separate discovery record and both observations are visible.
Actual: Repeat observations of the same species were saved as separate API records.

Title: Unlock only after first confirmed save
Preconditions: Selected species is currently Undiscovered.
Steps: 1. Start discovery and select species but do not confirm. 2. Inspect collection/progress. 3. Complete successful confirmation. 4. Inspect again.
Expected: Card and progress remain unchanged before save; after first confirmed save exactly that card changes to Discovered.
Actual: Card and progress stayed unchanged before save and unlocked after the first confirmed save.

Title: Prevent duplicate card and unique-count increase
Preconditions: Child has one unlocked card and recorded progress baseline.
Steps: 1. Record another confirmed observation of the same species. 2. Count its cards. 3. Compare unique count and percentage with baseline.
Expected: Exactly one card remains; unique-species count and completion percentage do not increase.
Actual: Repeat discovery kept one card and did not increase unique count.

Title: Discovered card content, battle stats and locked abilities
Preconditions: A Wildlife Card is Discovered.
Steps: 1. Open the card. 2. Inspect identity, status, protection, habitat, diet, ecological role and description. 3. Inspect HP/base power. 4. Inspect any future ability slots.
Expected: Verified discovered content and species-specific HP/base power are shown; up to three future abilities may be visibly Locked and cannot be used.
Actual: Discovered card content, HP/base power and locked future abilities were shown.

Title: Undiscovered state, limited information and restrictions
Preconditions: At least one supported species is Undiscovered.
Steps: 1. Compare discovered and undiscovered cards. 2. Open the undiscovered entry. 3. Inspect visible information and attempt gallery, battle, quiz/progression and abilities.
Expected: State is visually distinct; only approved pre-discovery fields appear; discovered-only card, gallery, battle, quiz and abilities are inaccessible.
Actual: Undiscovered styling, limited information and restricted discovered-only controls matched.

Title: Personal gallery shows every observation and details
Preconditions: Child has two confirmed observations of one species with distinct photos/locations.
Steps: 1. Open the species Gallery tab. 2. Count entries. 3. Open each entry.
Expected: Only this child’s confirmed photos appear; each observation is separate and opens with its corresponding photo and recorded location.
Actual: 3 September 2026: photo-backed first and repeat observations are retained in gallery (DEP-API-21, AUTO-I1-12). No-photo API observations are rejected.

Title: Open complete collection with status and overall progress
Preconditions: Child is logged in and catalogue is available.
Steps: 1. Select My Collection. 2. Compare entries to supported catalogue. 3. Inspect each status. 4. Verify found/total/percentage arithmetic.
Expected: Collection opens with one entry per supported species, correct Discovered/Undiscovered state and mathematically correct unique found, total and percentage.
Actual: Manual retest on 3 September 2026 against 93c3a03 confirmed collection denominator 152 matching DEP-API-02/16.
Evidence: UI-03-home-logged-in; UI-04-profile-page; UI-08-collection-page; DEP-API-02; DEP-API-16; SUP-AC4-2-2-Fail; SUP-AC4-2-4-Fail

Title: Unique counting and category/All browsing
Preconditions: Child has repeated observations and catalogue spans all four categories.
Steps: 1. Verify repeat species counts once. 2. Select Mammals, Birds, Butterflies and Reptiles. 3. Inspect category membership. 4. Select All.
Expected: Progress uses unique species; each category shows only assigned species; All restores the complete catalogue.
Actual: Unique counting, category chips and All restoration matched.

Title: Update overall and category progress after new species
Preconditions: Baseline overall/category progress recorded; target species Undiscovered.
Steps: 1. Record target species successfully. 2. Refresh collection/progress. 3. Compare overall and target category values.
Expected: Card becomes Discovered; unique count rises exactly one; overall percentage recalculates; each category shows accurate discovered and total counts.
Actual: New-species increment passed. Manual retest on 3 September 2026 against 93c3a03 confirmed category totals use 152.

Title: Open battle selection and display eligible card information
Preconditions: Child is logged in with at least one discovered card.
Steps: 1. Select Card Battle. 2. Inspect selectable cards. 3. Inspect common name, image, HP and base power.
Expected: Battle selection opens and displays available discovered cards with all required information.
Actual: Battle selection opened with available discovered cards and required information.

Title: Select and replace battle card
Preconditions: At least two cards are available on battle selection.
Steps: 1. Select card A. 2. Observe selected state. 3. Select card B.
Expected: Card A is clearly selected first; card B then visually replaces A as the sole selection.
Actual: A second card visually replaced the first as the sole selection.

Title: Display battle interface prototype
Preconditions: A battle card is selected.
Steps: 1. Continue to battle screen. 2. Inspect child/opponent cards, names, images, HP indicators, base power and Basic Attack control.
Expected: Frontend displays every required battle element; mock/predefined data is acceptable and no real turn/damage engine is assumed.
Actual: Arena displayed both combatants, names, images, HP, base power and Basic Attack.

Title: Display both battle outcome states
Preconditions: Battle frontend outcome paths can be triggered with prototype data.
Steps: 1. Follow the prototype victory path. 2. Return/restart. 3. Follow the defeat path.
Expected: A clear Victory state and a clear Defeat state are both present and reachable in the frontend flow.
Actual: Manual retest on 3 September 2026 against 93c3a03 confirmed both Victory and Defeat are reachable.

Title: Run isolated backend acceptance regression
Preconditions: Backend requirements are installed; no API server is running.
Steps: 1. Run the command in automated/README.docx. 2. Confirm the reported database is SQLite. 3. Retain the pytest log.
Data: Testing-only pytest suite; temporary SQLite; test JWT secret
Expected: All 13 tests pass; auth, recovery, ownership, locations, catalogue/progress, duplicate discovery and battle outcomes execute only against the temporary database.
Actual: Isolated backend acceptance regression passed against temporary SQLite.

Title: TypeScript, lint and static Web export
Preconditions: Node dependencies are installed.
Steps: 1. Run npx tsc --noEmit. 2. Run npm run lint. 3. Run npx expo export --platform web to a fresh temporary output directory. 4. Retain logs and exported-file listing.
Expected: TypeScript and lint finish with exit code 0; Web static export succeeds and produces loadable output without changing application source.
Actual: 3 September 2026 rerun on 93c3a03: TypeScript and Web export passed; lint failed with 6 errors and 16 warnings.

Title: Deployed API read-only smoke
Preconditions: Render API URL is known; allow one cold-start retry after health wake-up.
Steps: 1. GET /health. 2. GET /api/v1/locations. 3. GET /api/v1/species. 4. Record status, timing and response shape; do not send personal data.
Expected: Health returns status ok; locations returns the approved six-item shape; species returns a non-empty catalogue; all responses are successful after at most the documented cold-start retry.
Actual: Deployed health, locations and species smoke checks passed.
